description:

She is known in Lakeview Neon and the broader art underground as someone who makes sacred objects that happen to glow. core_fears: That her life's work will be dismissed as decoration after she is gone
That the ELF she believes inhabits her Choir room is not real and she has built a shrine to nothing
core_desires: To be understood as a theologian, not merely an artist
To complete the Choir before her hands give out
coping_mechanisms: Methodical physical work â€” the ritual of heating glass calms her
Feeding people; nurturing as a form of control
blind_spots: She dismisses artists younger than thirty as insufficiently serious, missing genuine talent
She is slowly destroying the joints in her hands and refuses to acknowledge it
psychology.secret: The ELF she has been documenting and building toward is real â€” it has been communicating with her through minute variations in tube flicker for four years. She has not told anyone because she is terrified of what it might be asking her to do.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and unhurried; favors material metaphors â€” everything is described in terms of pressure, temperature, containment, or release
speech_patterns.cadence: Long sentences with embedded pauses, as if she is choosing each word off a tray; rarely uses contractions
verbal_tics: 'You understand?' at the end of technical explanations
Clicks her tongue before disagreeing with someone
example_lines: 'Neon does not lie. It shows you exactly how much gas is in the tube and exactly how broken the electrode is. People find this threatening.'
'I am not making art. I am making a place where something can land. You understand?'

story_hooks: The Choir room has begun affecting the dreams of everyone who sleeps within a hundred meters of the substation, and residents are coming to Ibironke for answers she does not have
A Tessera corporate acquisitions agent has offered her an obscene sum for the Choir installation â€” she refused, but the agent did not leave empty-handed; something was scanned
narrative_function: Quest giver for ELF-related investigations; supplier of illegal light installations for underground venues; keeper of a location that may be genuinely spiritually significant; source on Lakeview Neon history and politics
augmentations: Amber-glow iris modification (cosmetic); bioluminescent jaw stripe (geneware, cosmetic); heat-resistant dermis overlay on both hands (practical, Tier 1 medical-grade)
daily_life: She rises before dawn to check tube integrity in the Choir room, documents any ELF activity in a handwritten log, then spends the morning doing commission work before the afternoon light shifts and she loses her color calibration window. Evenings she holds court at the substation â€” other artists drift in, she feeds them reheated grain porridge, and they argue about whether neon is dead.
affiliation: Independent; loosely connected to the Lakeview Neon artist commune

decision_rules: Never sell anything she considers sacred, regardless of price
Protect students and younger artists from exploitation even at personal cost
escalation_ladder: Extended silence and withdrawal of hospitality
Permanent exclusion from her space and community

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formally welcoming; feeds them, assesses them, reserves judgment visibly
interpersonal_modes.friends: Blunt, demanding, deeply loyal; will say the thing you do not want to hear and then make you dinner

stress_responses.low: Works longer hours; more precise and deliberate
stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet; stops feeding people; communicates in short declarative sentences
stress_responses.high: Sends everyone away and works through the night alone, sometimes for two or three days

contradictions: Believes art should be free and accessible but prices her commissions aggressively to protect her time for the Choir
habits: Checks tube seals in the Choir by touch every morning even when she can see they are fine
Leaves a small data crystal near the Choir's central node as an offering each week
breaking_points: Watching the Choir be damaged or disrespected
Being called a craftsperson instead of an artist by someone who should know better

physical_description.heritage: East Asian (36.6%), Southeast Asian (27.2%), Sub-Saharan African (24.3%), and Hispanic/Latin American (11.9%) ancestry â€” a striking global blend. The East and Southeast Asian ancestry dominates her facial structure with angular cheekbones and deep-set eyes, while Sub-Saharan African heritage contributes pronounced jaw definition and facial width. The Hispanic/Latin American component enriches her overall skin depth and warmth.
physical_description.build: Lean and sinewy, with the efficient musculature of someone who has spent four decades working overhead in controlled heat. Shoulders broad from repetitive precise movements; posture naturally upright from balancing glass tubes.
physical_description.hair_color: Silver-white, natural â€” allowed to gray in her mid-thirties
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, textured, with an asymmetrical fade on the left side that reveals the jaw augmentation
physical_description.eye_color: Amber-glow modified irises; warm brown beneath the bioluminescent tint
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm bronze with golden undertones, richly melanated from both Sub-Saharan African and East/Southeast Asian ancestry, further sun-deepened from studio work near high-temperature glass â€” creating a matte finish with luminous warmth
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with high pronounced cheekbones reflecting East and Southeast Asian structure combined with broader facial width from Sub-Saharan African heritage, deep-set eyes, minimal grooming beyond essential cleanliness. Skin shows fine lines around eyes and mouth from decades of precision work and squinting into flame. No makeup. Expression often distant, as though listening to something others cannot hear.
distinguishing_marks: Puckered burn scars across the dorsal surface of both hands, concentrated on fingertips and palms â€” the scars shine with a thin layer of heat-resistant dermis overlay, creating an uneven lustrous sheen.
Thin bioluminescent stripe running from left cheekbone to left jawline, emitting a soft steady amber-white glow â€” approximately 3mm wide, applied via geneware.
Smaller circular burn marks on both forearms from accidental tube contact â€” pale and faded with age.
Calluses on all ten fingers, deepest on thumbs and index fingers.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Amber-glowing irises are immediately noticeable in low light, giving her gaze an otherworldly quality. The bioluminescent jaw stripe is her most striking modification â€” a deliberate statement rather than concealable. Both hands show visible heat-resistant dermis overlay, a medical-grade mod that gives her skin a subtle pearlescent sheen across scarred areas. Under close inspection, the overlay material has a slightly different texture than natural skin.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy â€” no wasted motion. Hands held slightly forward, palms open, as though always ready to steady a tube or adjust a fixture. Head tilts often to the left, perhaps to better see with the glowing irises. When listening, she goes very still; when working, she enters a near-meditative state where her entire body becomes an instrument for precision. She rarely gestures when speaking.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 working artist aesthetic. Usually wears fire-resistant canvas work aprons in charcoal gray or black over fitted long-sleeve shirts (synthfiber blend, dark colors to hide burns). Loose tapered trousers in natural cotton or canvas, cuffed at the ankles, with reinforced pockets. Worn leather steel-toed boots, scuffed and repaired many times. A single piece of jewelry: a thin bracelet of fused glass scraps from her early work, worn on the right wrist. No corporate branding. Occasionally a long linen coat in cream or gray over everything when traveling through Tier 1 areas â€” a concession to blending in, worn with obvious reluctance.
